elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Garman must provide transition assistance to Sparkling.
elements.evidence: The added language applies upon expiry or termination for any reason and requires Garman, at Sparkling's request, to provide transition assistance.

elements.element: The transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The clause guarantees assistance only for at least 90 calendar days; it does not require availability for six months.

elements.element: The transition assistance must be provided at Garman's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state any rate or fee basis for transition assistance.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Garman must return Sparkling's Customer Data to Sparkling.
elements.evidence: Garman must export and deliver to Sparkling all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Sparkling.

elements.element: Garman must return the Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires export and delivery within 30 calendar days after expiry or termination.

elements.element: The returned Customer Data must be in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Although the clause requires data to be exported and delivered, it does not expressly require a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: After returning the Customer Data, Garman must certify its deletion.
elements.evidence: No deletion or deletion-certification obligation is imposed on Garman.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Garman must provide transition assistance to Sparkling.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Garman, at Sparkling's request, to provide transition assistance upon expiry or termination for any reason.

elements.element: The transition assistance must be available for 90 days.
elements.evidence: The clause requires transition assistance for at least 90 calendar days, thereby guaranteeing the fallback's 90-day period.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Garman must export Sparkling's Customer Data to Sparkling.
elements.evidence: The clause requires Garman to export and deliver all data belonging to, supplied by, or processed for Sparkling.

elements.element: Garman must complete the data export within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The export and delivery deadline is expressly 30 calendar days after expiry or termination.

result.reason: The redline fully reaches the fallback but not the preferred position: it lacks a six-month assistance period, then-current rates, an express standard machine-readable format, and deletion certification. It preserves the existing termination and perpetual-license terms and adds no contradiction. It is not strictly minimal because “at least ninety (90) calendar days” creates an uncapped assistance duration beyond the specified 90-day fallback; using “for ninety (90) calendar days” would have been sufficient. Drafting quality is also reduced by that open-ended duration and the absence of an express data-export format.
